title: Mobile SDK v2 — Offline Support
description:
Build the next major version of Nexora's mobile SDK with offline-first architecture. Data sync via background jobs when connectivity restored.

This is a parallel track to Payments (NEX-204) and does not share engineering resources. Mobile team is autonomous on this initiative.

Mentioned in email_10 Q4 all hands recap and all_hands_q4 meeting notes as a Q4 priority.
